title: Segmented Pill
description: A segmented control whose white pill slides to the selected item with a small squash, keyboard ready, as a motion variant beside the stock toggle group.

loop.script: click[1] → wait → click[2] → wait → click[0] → wait

docs:
Installed `SegmentedPill`. Import it from `@/components/ui/segmented-pill` and pass `items` (`value`, `label`, optional `disabled`) and an `aria-label`:

```tsx
const [value, setValue] = useState("overview");

<SegmentedPill
  aria-label="Section"
  items={[
    { value: "overview", label: "Overview" },
    { value: "activity", label: "Activity" },
    { value: "settings", label: "Settings" },
  ]}
  value={value}
  onValueChange={setValue}
  animated
/>
```

`animated` slides the pill with a small stretch and squash (off by default, as upstream, and never under reduced motion). The same API ships on four bases: the default is upstream's own tablist (selection follows the arrow keys); `-radix` and `-base` are toggle groups (the arrows move focus, Space or Enter selects); `-aria` is a React Aria radio group (the arrows select). It sits beside shadcn's `toggle-group`, which it does not replace.

The styles live in the component file and are hoisted into `<head>` once. Theme it with `--segmented-pill-track`, `-pill`, `-text`, `-text-active`, `-focus` and `-shadow` (in the item's light and dark cssVars), and per instance with `--segmented-pill-radius`, `-gap`, `-padding`, `-duration`, `-easing` and `-font-family` (upstream's stack starts with Geist and falls back to the system sans; set it to `var(--font-sans)` to use your app font). Labels are any React node, so an icon from your icon set can sit beside the text.

Ported from danielwh2/segmented-pill (MIT, copyright 2026 Daniel Belyi); the license notice is at the end of every file.

props.name: items
props.type: readonly { value: string; label: React.ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }[]
props.description: The segments. Values must be unique; at least one must be enabled.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The selected value (controlled) or the initial one. Without either, the first enabled item is selected.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the visitor selects another item.

props.name: animated
props.description: Slide the pill (260 ms) with a small squash. Reduced motion always turns both off.

props.name: ...attributes
props.description: Other attributes go on the root: aria-label or aria-labelledby (required), className and style (where the --segmented-pill-* variables can be set).

a11y: Default variant (upstream's model): role=tablist with role=tab items, aria-selected, one tab stop; the arrow keys (mirrored in right to left), Home and End move and select, Enter and Space select. Disabled items are skipped. There are no tab panels: the control switches content the app renders.

Radix and Base UI variants: a radio group of toggle buttons (Radix: role=radio, aria-checked) or a group of pressed buttons (Base UI: aria-pressed); the arrows move focus in the reading direction and Space or Enter selects. React Aria variant: a radio group (APG radio pattern) whose arrows select.
Every variant needs aria-label or aria-labelledby on the root.
Focus is a 2px #2563eb outline inside the item (5.2:1 on the white pill). Inactive labels are #52525b on the track (6.8:1).

Fidelity default, contrast on request: the white pill on the 5% track is 1.1:1, so the selected item also darkens its label; under prefers-contrast: more every label takes the active color and the pill gets a 1px outline in it, and under forced colors the pill is Highlight with HighlightText.
Reduced motion: the pill moves without sliding or squashing.
